metadata.title: When you accidentally flex on enemies with that 1 lucky kill LOL what even just happened?
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just clutch that kill by pure accident?
My aim was definitely not invited but hey, we take it.
Click if you’ve ever gotten a kill and immediately said ‘How?!’
Tap if Valorant’s making no sense but we love it anyway.

Hit that play button if your best kills are accidents too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
